senses.sense_definition: A group of related African languages within the Niger-Congo family, spoken across parts of the Sahel and savanna regions.

examples.text: Linguists classify Dagbani as a member of <w>Gur</w>.
Millions of people across West Africa speak various languages that belong to <w>Gur</w>.

senses.sense_definition: Pertaining to the Gur branch of the Niger-Congo language family or the peoples who speak these languages.

examples.text: She published a detailed study on the phonological features of <w>Gur</w> languages.
Several tonal patterns are characteristic of the <w>Gur</w> linguistic branch.
